result.title: Concept-Guided Prompting Strategies Increase Diversity in LLM-Generated Recipe Populations
result.summary: Novelty in solution generation supports automated discovery, but LLM outputs can remain repetitive. To address this, we propose a simple concept-guided prompting method that generates thematic concepts before responses within each of these concepts. To demonstrate, we generated 1,000 recipes for a recipe book task and compared the results against a human-authored corpus. Two naive prompting strategies were compared as baselines. Concept-guided prompting outperformed both baselines in all cases and reached semantic coverage of 47.0% versus 35.1% and 13.1% in respective prior-title and nonce prompt strategies. These findings suggest broader population exploration and diversity, but remain contained to this specific task. Further work is needed to determine the quality of solutions and generalizability.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一种简单的「概念引导」提示方法：先生成主题概念，再在各概念内生成回答；在 1000 条食谱生成任务上，与两种朴素提示策略及人类语料比较，语义覆盖率达 47.0%，高于基线的 35.1% 与 13.1%。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先产生概念再生成」的中间状态与语义覆盖指标，可能可供核查 latent 假设的多样化采样与覆盖度评价，但该工作限于纯文本食谱生成、未涉及视觉推理，联系仅为概念层面的启发。
